articles.summary: By adding title analytics, portfolio diligence, and real estate document generation capability, Stewart enhances its capital markets and servicing capabilities Stewart Information Services Corporation (NYSE: STC) today announced it has acquired ProTitleUSA (ProTitle) and DocSolutionUSA (DocSolution), two companies that together provide a comprehensive suite of title, mortgage related documents and due diligence services that support servicers, investors and capital markets clients throughout the real estate and mortgage lifecycle. “Both of these companies bring specialized expertise that aligns with Stewart’s long-term strategy for our centralized title services,” said Fred Eppinger, Stewart CEO. “Together with our existing offerings these businesses expand our scale in title services, strengthen our lender and servicer offerings for investors and capital market clients and add innovative analytic and document generation capabilities that are highly complementary to our existing
articles.title: Stewart Strengthens Title Capabilities Through Acquisition of ProTitleUSA and DocSolutionUSA
